title: Max Energy Non-Equilibrium
description: Essential Criteria: The maximum possible value of E/N for non-equilibrium must be stated as epsilon.

title: Max Energy Equilibrium
description: Essential Criteria: The maximum possible value of E/N for equilibrium must be stated as epsilon/2.

title: Entropy Function
description: Important Criteria: The expression for entropy per atom S/N as a function of E/N must be correctly derived.

title: Correct Limits
description: Important Criteria: The conditions for E/epsilon and N - E/epsilon being large must be acknowledged in the entropy derivation.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign errors in the final expressions for E/N or S/N will lead to a deduction.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any mistakes in maintaining consistent units throughout the calculations will result in a deduction.
